knownIssues: Keep the existing ODT app running on API port 5190 and UI port 5189 during demos.
Do not treat terminal worker completion as sufficient; worker output must be ingested back into ODT.
approvalNotes: Writes, dependency installs, PR creation, and deployment require explicit human approval.
Preserve the frozen baseline and validate Agent Team relay behavior after workflow changes.
evidenceNotes: Run `npm run check` in the enterprise folder after repository/module changes.
Use Agent Team relay smoke after Agent Team, workflow, relay, or evidence changes.

knownIssues: Plain `npm run build` can fail on Webpack 4/OpenSSL 3 hash behavior; use NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider for readiness evidence.
Targeted Jest can pass while the overall command exits non-zero because of unrelated obsolete snapshot cleanup.
Worktree-based local Docker testing may not reflect changes if docker sync points at the default repo path.
approvalNotes: Do not create PRs, push branches, deploy, or update external tickets without explicit approval.
For completed Jira work, run reviewer/build verifier flow before PR readiness.
evidenceNotes: Record exact test command, status, and environment note in ODT implementation evidence.
For layout defects, include manual/browser/visual evidence when jsdom cannot prove layout behavior.
